0022600017.text: The Detroit Pistons (4-1, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East, on a W1 streak) visit the Brooklyn Nets (0-4, 15th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, on a four-game losing streak). Detroit is without Jalen Duren, who is out with a hamstring strain, and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder sprain, and Egor Demin is day-to-day with a leg bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
